items.Sentence: The Facility is an extended aeration activated sludge package plant.
The Facility includes a chlorine contact chamber; however, chlorine is not currently used in the contact chamber since WDRs Order 85-255 did not require the effluent to be disinfected.
The effluent is discharged to an unlined percolation/evaporation pond.

Since the original construction (1980s), the effluent percolation/evaporation pond was divided into two ponds by a dirt berm (which function now in series) and an external anaerobic sludge digester was added. Approximately 1,500 gallons of sludge is pumped from the digester by an approved hauler every 21 days or sooner as needed.
